1. Thinta inkinobho engezansi.
2. Vula “Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakiwe” noma “Izinhlelo zokusebenza ezilandiwe”.
3. Khetha i-Mareco bese uyivula.
4. Buyela lapha.

Isevisi yokufinyeleleka: indlela kuphela i-Android evumela ngayo uhlelo lokusebenza ukuthinta nokuswayipha ngawe. I-Mareco iyisebenzisa ukudweba izilawuli ezintantayo, ukubeka isendlalelo esingabonakali esikrinini uma urekhoda, nokuphinda izenzo zakho. Ayikwazi ukufunda isikrini sakho, amaphasiwedi akho noma imilayezo yakho.

Ukucindezela izinkinobho: kuphela lapho urekhoda noma usebenza, ukuze i-Mareco ikwazi ukurekhoda “Emuva”, “Ekhaya” kanye “Izinhlelo zokusebenza zakamuva” futhi ikwazi ukubona ukumisa okuphuthumayo kwe-“Khuphula ivolumu” + “Ncipha ivolumu”. Umbhalo obhaliwe awukaze ugcinwe.
Uhlelo lokusebenza olusephambili: lusetshenziswa kuphela ukuphepha okukhethwayo “Sebenza kuphela uma lolu hlelo lokusebenza luvuliwe”.
I-Mareco ayinayo imvume ye-inthanethi nhlobo, ngakho akukho lutho olungaphuma kufoni yakho.

I-Android 13 nakwabasha ivimbela izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifakwe ngaphandle kwe-Google Play ekusebenziseni ukufinyeleleka, kuze uvume lokho:
1. Thinta “Vula ulwazi lohlelo lokusebenza”.
2. Thinta amachashaza amathathu aphezulu kwesokudla.
3. Khetha “Vumela izilungiselelo ezinqunyiwe” bese uqinisekisa.
4. Buyela emuva bese uvula isevisi.

Ngezikhathi ezinde beka ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri ye-Mareco ku-“Akukhawulelwe” (Ulwazi lohlelo lokusebenza → Ibhethri) bese ugcina ichaja lixhunyiwe. Ngenkathi imakro isebenza, i-Mareco igcina isikrini sivulekile.

Inkinobho ehlazayo ● / ▶: iqala ukurekhoda (imodi Rekhoda imakro) noma isebenzisa imakro yakho (imodi Qala imakro). Lapho irekhoda noma isebenza, iba ■: yicindezele ukuze umise. Ngemva kokurekhoda ikucela ukuthi unike igama bese uligcina.
Bamba inkinobho ehlazayo: misa isikhashana noma uqhubeke (lapho urekhoda noma usebenza), noma umise (lapho kumisiwe isikhashana).
Isithonjana sezilungiselelo: khetha imodi Rekhoda imakro noma Qala imakro, khetha imakro yakho ezenzakalelayo, ushintshe izilungiselelo zokusebenza zayo kanye nezinye izilungiselelo zonke.
Imicibisholo emine: donsa ibha uyiyise noma kuphi. X: vala ibha (uyivule futhi kusuka kuhlelo lokusebenza). Cindezela isikhashana inkinobho ukuze ubone igama layo.

1. Ku-Mareco, cindezela Qala ukurekhoda. Ibha elintantayo liyavela.
2. Vula umdlalo wakho.
3. Cindezela inkinobho ehlazayo ● uma usulungele.
4. Yenza izenzo zakho ngokwejwayelekile.
5. Cindezela ■ bese unikeza imakro igama.
6. Isithonjana sezilungiselelo → Qala imakro, lungisa izilungiselelo zokusebenza bese ucindezela ▶.
Misa noma nini ngo-■, ngenkinobho ethi MISA kuhlelo lokusebenza, noma ngokucindezela inkinobho yokukhuphula ivolumu kanye nenkinobho yokuncipha ivolumu ndawonye.
Okuqondile (okuzenzakalelayo): i-Mareco irekhoda ukuthinta kwakho futhi iphindaphinde ngayinye izenzo kuhlelo lokusebenza ngemva nje kokuphakamisa umunwe wakho, ukuze umdlalo usabele uma urekhoda.
Plan: ukuthinta kurekhodwa kuphela; uhlelo lokusebenza alusabeli. Sebenzisa lokhu uma okuqondile kubangela izinkinga.

• Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukubona ukuthinta okuya kolunye uhlelo lokusebenza. Yingakho ukurekhoda kusebenzisa isendlalelo esidlulisayo futhi kuphinda izenzo zakho. Ukuthinta okusha ngesikhathi esincane kakhulu ngenkathi isenzo siphindwa kungase kuphuthelwe, ngakho gwema ukuthinta okusheshayo kakhulu okuphindaphindwayo uma urekhoda, noma sebenzisa imodi yePlan.
• Amanye amaskrini avimba izenzo ezizenzakalelayo: izindawo zamaphasiwedi, izinhlelo zokusebenza zebhange nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezivimba amathuluzi okufinyeleleka.
• Emuva, Ekhaya nezinhlelo zokusebenza zakamuva kuphela ezingarekhodwa njengokucindezela izinkinobho. Ivolumu, ikhamera nezinye izinkinobho azikwazi ukuphindwa.
• Akukho okusebenzayo lapho isikrini sivaliwe noma sikhiyiwe. I-Mareco igcina isikrini sivulekile ngesikhathi imakro isebenza futhi iyayeka uma sivaliwe.
• Rekhoda futhi uphinde ngesimo esifanayo. Uma usayizi wesikrini wehluka, i-Mareco iyalinganisa izixhumanisi futhi iyakwazisa.
• I-Android ingase imise izinhlelo zokusebenza ngemuva ukuze isindise ibhethri. Setha ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri kwe-Mareco kube “Akukhawulelwe” ngezikhathi ezinde.
